meta.rationale: The sky outside your window, at the real time of day: dawn, noon, dusk or stars. Your apps drift by as clouds.
meta.theme-about: living sky: a full-screen canvas whose sky follows the real clock (pink dawn, blue noon, orange dusk, deep night with stars and a moon), the sun or moon moving along a real arc, soft rolling hills at the bottom, the apps as fluffy clouds drifting slowly across with their names written on them in a rounded font; hover a cloud and it brightens, click it to open; a big thin clock floats in the sky. Peaceful, ambient, always changing. (#sky, #hour)

desktop.canvas: local clouds, hot = {}, nil local function mix(a, b, k) local function c(s, i) return tonumber(s:sub(i, i + 1), 16) end local r = c(a, 2) + (c(b, 2) - c(a, 2)) * k local gg = c(a, 4) + (c(b, 4) - c(a, 4)) * k local bb = c(a, 6) + (c(b, 6) - c(a, 6)) * k return string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", math.floor(r), math.floor(gg), math.floor(bb)) end local KEYS = {{0, "#0b1030", "#1c2350"}, {5.5, "#2a2a5a", "#e88aa0"}, {7, "#7fb4ff", "#ffd6a0"}, {12, "#3f8cff", "#a8d4ff"}, {17.5, "#5a7ad8", "#ffc890"}, {19.5, "#3a2a6a", "#ff8a5a"}, {21, "#141a40", "#2a2a5a"}, {24, "#0b1030", "#1c2350"}} function draw(w, h, t) local hh = g.clock() local top, bot for i = 1, #KEYS - 1 do local a, b = KEYS[i], KEYS[i + 1] if hh >= a[1] and hh <= b[1] then local k = (hh - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]) top, bot = mix(a[2], b[2], k), mix(a[3], b[3], k) end end g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, top or "#3f8cff", bot or "#a8d4ff") local night = hh < 6 or hh > 20 if night then for i = 0, 120 do local sx, sy = (i * 211.7) % w, (i * 97.3) % (h * 0.7) g.circle(sx, sy, (i % 3 == 0) and 1.6 or 1, string.format("rgba(255,255,255,%.2f)", 0.4 + 0.4 * math.sin(t + i))) end end local day = ((hh - 6) / 12) local sx = w * (0.1 + 0.8 * (night and ((hh + 6) % 24) / 12 or day)) local sy = h * 0.75 - math.sin(math.max(0, math.min(1, night and ((hh + 6) % 24) / 12 or day)) * math.pi) * h * 0.55 if night then g.circle(sx, sy, 34, "#f4f0dc") g.circle(sx + 12, sy - 8, 30, top or "#0b1030") else g.glow(sx, sy, 160, "rgba(255,230,160,0.45)") g.circle(sx, sy, 44, "#fff2b8") end local hills = {{0.8, "rgba(60,120,80,0.75)", 0.3}, {0.88, "rgba(40,100,60,0.9)", 0.5}} for _, hl in ipairs(hills) do local pts = {0, h} for x = 0, 32 do pts[#pts + 1] = x * w / 32 pts[#pts + 1] = h * hl[1] - math.sin(x * hl[3] + 1) * 40 - math.sin(x * 0.17) * 30 end pts[#pts + 1] = w pts[#pts + 1] = h g.poly(pts, night and "rgba(10,20,30,0.9)" or hl[2]) end local apps = g.apps() local px, py, over = g.pointer() clouds, hot = {}, nil for i, a in ipairs(apps) do if i > 9 then break end local speed = 8 + (i * 7 % 5) * 3 local x = ((t * speed + i * 377) % (w + 400)) - 200 local y = h * (0.42 + ((i * 0.11) % 0.32)) clouds[#clouds + 1] = {x = x, y = y, name = a.name, id = a.id, s = 1 + (i % 3) * 0.15} end for _, c in ipairs(clouds) do if over and math.abs(px - c.x) < 90 * c.s and math.abs(py - c.y) < 40 * c.s then hot = c.id end end for _, c in ipairs(clouds) do local a = c.id == hot and 1 or 0.88 local col = night and string.format("rgba(200,210,240,%.2f)", a * 0.55) or string.format("rgba(255,255,255,%.2f)", a) local s = c.s g.circle(c.x - 50 * s, c.y + 6 * s, 30 * s, col) g.circle(c.x, c.y - 10 * s, 42 * s, col) g.circle(c.x + 48 * s, c.y + 4 * s, 32 * s, col) g.rect(c.x - 80 * s, c.y + 4 * s, 160 * s, 32 * s, col, 16 * s) g.text(c.x - #c.name * 4.8, c.y, c.name, night and "#ffffff" or "#2a5fae", 18, "Outfit") end end function click(x, y) for _, c in ipairs(clouds) do if math.abs(x - c.x) < 90 * c.s and math.abs(y - c.y) < 40 * c.s then return "open:" .. c.id end end end
